question.prompt: A 30 m fence is used to enclose a rectangular vegetable garden with one side along a wall (the wall is long enough). Let the side perpendicular to the wall have length $x$ m. Find the maximum area of the garden. (Unit: m²; a decimal answer is allowed.)

solutions.explanation: The side parallel to the wall has length $30-2x$. The area is $S=x(30-2x)=-2(x-7.5)^2+112.5$. Since $x=7.5$ lies within the allowable range $0<x<15$, the maximum area is 112.5.
solutions.title: Model and maximize the garden area
